capabilities: : Extract atomic notes from text, URL, or clipboard
: Filter low-quality content using multi-dimensional rules
: Deduplicate notes within a batch and across the vault
: Verify factual claims using a three-layer pipeline
: Recommend related notes based on content similarity
extras: Processes data locally before sending necessary data to the DeepSeek API; API Key is encrypted using AES-256-GCM.
intentEvidence: This plugin helps you transform long articles, web pages, or selected text into well-structured atomic notes using AI, with automatic deduplication before saving to your vault.
motivation: To transform read content into personal atomic notes locally, ensuring privacy and high knowledge quality.
problem: Converting long, unstructured content into actionable, retrievable knowledge nodes is time-consuming and often results in low-quality or redundant notes.
summary: AI-powered note extractor that uses DeepSeek to transform long articles and web pages into standardized, deduplicated atomic notes.
